title: These birds are too cute!
text: These birds are too cute!. Such a group of comical birds - I smiled when I saw them, and I hope the friend I gave this too did as well.  I got one for myself, and use it often.  The mug is a great size for a morning cup of coffee or cocoa, and I use mine often.  Vicki Sawyer's designs are just darling and always bring a smile!
